DEMO-18324.summary: Add AI-owned enrichment summary field writeback
DEMO-18324.description: Allow the enrichment pipeline to write only to the AI Implementation Brief and AI Enrichment Summary fields.
acceptance_criteria: Only AI-owned fields may be updated.
A stale Jira issue must block writeback.
Approval is required when confidence is below threshold.

DEMO-18325.description: When Confluence and Bitbucket evidence are insufficient, request structured reviewer input and re-run enrichment.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer identity and timestamp must be stored.
edge_cases: Reviewer input conflicts with Jira description
comments: This should not become a free-form chat channel.

DEMO-18326.summary: Persist run state in MVP filesystem schema
DEMO-18326.description: Use deterministic filesystem paths for run, draft, evidence, approval, and event persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Replay from dead-letter must be supported.
